requirements.text: Advanced expertise in designing and implementing Spring Boot microservices architectures supporting high-volume transactions and complex business requirements in enterprise environments.
Strong proficiency in Java-based full stack engineering for commerce platforms, including backend services, integration patterns, and modern web application technologies.
Extensive experience with API design, RESTful services, and data modeling for highly scalable distributed systems.
Hands-on experience with testing frameworks, build tools, CI/CD practices, and version control systems to support reliable software delivery.
Strong knowledge of performance tuning, caching strategies, asynchronous processing, and application scalability techniques.
Solid understanding of security best practices, authentication and authorization mechanisms, and data protection strategies for customer-facing applications.
Experience with containerized deployments and cloud-ready architectures supporting enterprise-scale applications.
Experience defining enterprise architecture standards and governance across large-scale digital commerce ecosystems.
Proven ability to lead technical teams and influence architectural decisions across multiple product and engineering groups.
Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and operational excellence practices within microservices environments.
Strong background translating complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable architectural solutions.
Knowledge of modern Java ecosystem advancements and experience evaluating emerging frameworks, tools, and architectural patterns.
open to qualified applicants located close to or in Sunnyvale, CA, United States
Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.
